mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_user_provider_configs (user_id, provider, base_url, api_key_ciphertext, model, enabled) VALUES (#{config.userId}, #{config.provider}, #{config.baseUrl}, #{config.apiKeyCiphertext}, #{config.model}, #{config.enabled}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE provider = VALUES(provider), base_url = VALUES(base_url), api_key_ciphertext = VALUES(api_key_ciphertext), model = VALUES(model), enabled = VALUES(enabled)
